avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may increase hydrocortisone metabolism and reduce therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before initiating St. John's Wort

avoid_supplements.name: Licorice root (high doses)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Licorice enhances mineralocorticoid effects and sodium/fluid retention; additive corticosteroid effects increase hypokalemia and hypertension risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation; monitor potassium and blood pressure if use unavoidable

caution_supplements.name: Calcium and Vitamin D supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Hydrocortisone impairs calcium absorption and increases bone loss; supplementation may mitigate corticosteroid-induced osteoporosis
caution_supplements.action: Consider monitoring bone density; adequate supplementation recommended with long-term hydrocortisone use

caution_supplements.name: Potassium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Hydrocortisone can cause hypokalemia; supplementation may help maintain normal potassium levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor serum potassium; supplementation may be beneficial depending on clinical context

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase hydrocortisone bioavailability and systemic exposure, elevating adverse effect risk
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit products; choose alternative beverages

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Hydrocortisone promotes sodium retention and fluid accumulation; excess dietary sodium may exacerbate hypertension and edema
caution_foods.action: Consider moderate sodium restriction; monitor blood pressure and fluid status

caution_foods.name: Potassium-rich foods (bananas, spinach, sweet potato)
caution_foods.mechanism: Hydrocortisone-induced hypokalemia may be partially offset by potassium-rich dietary sources
caution_foods.action: Monitor serum potassium; encourage adequate intake based on laboratory values

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum potassium, blood glucose, and blood pressure regularly during hydrocortisone therapy, as corticosteroids increase hypokalemia, hyperglycemia, and hypertension risk. Assess bone health in patients on prolonged therapy and consider osteoporosis prophylaxis with calcium/vitamin D supplementation.
